facts.business: Shree Rajasthan Syntex Ltd. is a player in the man-made fibre and filament spinning industry, manufacturing Polypropylene Multi filament Yarn with a capacity of 2000 TPA at its Texchem Division in Dungarpur, Rajasthan.

auditor.name: HM & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Company was levied a penalty of ₹41,300 under Regulation 23(9) of SEBI LODR for a clerical error in RPT disclosure date (mentioned 30.09.2024 instead of 30.09.2025), subsequently rectified by re-filing.

key_risks: Higher input costs compared to competing nations (high cost of capital and power)
Low technology level and outdated technologies in the textile industry
